-- P1: sum established authorized fees per current tool identity
WITH current_tools AS (
  SELECT tool_id, name FROM tool_record
),
alias_map AS (
  SELECT from_tool_id AS alias, to_tool_id AS current_tool_id FROM tool_identity_remap
  UNION ALL
  SELECT REPLACE(tool_id, 'tool:', '') AS alias, tool_id AS current_tool_id FROM tool_record
),
resolved_checkouts AS (
  SELECT cr.checkout_id,
         COALESCE(am.current_tool_id, 'tool:' || cr.tool_id) AS current_tool_id,
         cf.total_fee
  FROM checkout_record cr
  JOIN checkout_authorization ca ON ca.checkout_id = cr.checkout_id
  JOIN checkout_fee cf ON cf.checkout_id = cr.checkout_id
  LEFT JOIN alias_map am ON am.alias = cr.tool_id
  WHERE ca.status = 'authorized'
)
SELECT ct.tool_id, ct.name, ROUND(SUM(CAST(rc.total_fee AS REAL)), 1) AS total_authorized_fees
FROM current_tools ct
LEFT JOIN resolved_checkouts rc ON rc.current_tool_id = ct.tool_id
GROUP BY ct.tool_id, ct.name ORDER BY ct.tool_id
tasks.unresolved_handling: All current tool identities have established authorized checkout fees in checkout_fee; unauthorized checkouts excluded per checkout_authorization.status.

-- P2: M-17 checkouts with historical tool IDs resolved to current identity
WITH alias_map AS (
  SELECT from_tool_id AS alias, to_tool_id AS current_tool_id FROM tool_identity_remap
  UNION ALL
  SELECT REPLACE(tool_id, 'tool:', '') AS alias, tool_id AS current_tool_id FROM tool_record
)
SELECT cr.checkout_id, cr.tool_id AS recorded_tool_id,
       COALESCE(am.current_tool_id, 'tool:' || cr.tool_id) AS current_tool_id,
       tr.name AS current_tool_name, cr.out_time, cr.in_time, cr.note
FROM checkout_record cr
LEFT JOIN alias_map am ON am.alias = cr.tool_id
LEFT JOIN tool_record tr ON tr.tool_id = COALESCE(am.current_tool_id, 'tool:' || cr.tool_id)
WHERE cr.member_id = 'member:M-17'
ORDER BY cr.out_time
tasks.unresolved_handling: Historical alias L1 resolved to LASER-A via tool_identity_remap; all M-17 checkouts have resolvable tool identities.

-- P3: CNC-1 chain checkouts, members, authorized fee sum, unresolved notes
-- Checkouts on CNC-1 chain:
WITH alias_map AS (
  SELECT from_tool_id AS alias, to_tool_id AS current_tool_id FROM tool_identity_remap
  UNION ALL
  SELECT REPLACE(tool_id, 'tool:', '') AS alias, tool_id AS current_tool_id FROM tool_record
)
SELECT cr.checkout_id, cr.member_id, mr.name, ca.status, cf.total_fee, cr.note
FROM checkout_record cr
LEFT JOIN alias_map am ON am.alias = cr.tool_id
JOIN checkout_authorization ca ON ca.checkout_id = cr.checkout_id
JOIN checkout_fee cf ON cf.checkout_id = cr.checkout_id
JOIN member_record mr ON mr.member_id = cr.member_id
WHERE COALESCE(am.current_tool_id, 'tool:' || cr.tool_id) = 'tool:CNC-1'
ORDER BY cr.out_time;

-- Unresolved note meanings (purpose_requirement_failure):
SELECT subject_json, grounding_ref FROM purpose_requirement_failure
WHERE requirement_id = 'checkout_note_meaning'
